wells.name: 15/9-F-11 B
wells.surveyNote: Definitive 15/9-F-11 A survey to the 2585 m MD sidetrack point; below it a smooth path through the 33 official formation-pick coordinates of this wellbore.
wells.summary: Horizontal Hugin Fm producer. Shares the upper hole with 15/9-F-11 A and was sidetracked from it at ~2585 m MD, then landed near-horizontal and weaves through the thin Hugin reservoir seven times.

wells.name: 15/9-F-11 A
wells.summary: Deviated (≈40°) pilot wellbore with a full reservoir log suite including compressional and shear sonic, plus Equinor's computed petrophysical interpretation (CPI).

wells.name: 15/9-F-1 C
wells.surveyNote: No public definitive survey: smooth path through the 16 official formation-pick coordinates.
wells.summary: High-angle producer (later converted to water injector) with Equinor CPI and daily production 2014–2016.

wells.name: 15/9-F-12
wells.surveyNote: Public MD/INC/AZI survey file; positions by minimum curvature. Deviates by up to ~29 m from the official pick coordinates (datum/version differences), so shown as context only.
wells.summary: Volve's most prolific producer (≈4.6 million Sm³ oil). Survey, tops and production are public; logs are not included in this demo package.
